sheet_TokenUnlocks.token_unlocks_explainer_locked: Locked tokens cannot be sold today and are restricted programmatically or via real-life contractual agreements according to the release schedule.  Burnt tokens are deducted from this figure.
sheet_TokenUnlocks.token_unlocks_explainer_unlocked: Unlocked tokens are tokens that can be sold with no restriction today. Burnt tokens are deducted from this figure.
sheet_TokenUnlocks.token_unlocks_explainer_untracked: Untracked tokens are unaccounted for in the token unlock schedule. This could be due to factors such as unminted tokens or methodological differences. Untracked = Max (MS, TS) - (locked + unlocked at the terminal point on the Unlock Schedule chart).

sheet_TokenUnlocks.token_unlocks_tip_small_tu: Include token unlocks that are < 1% of the token supply
sheet_TokenUnlocks.token_unlocks_title_description_web: Listed below are the token unlocks and vesting details for leading crypto projects. For full tokenomics information, please click on the token name to be taken to the relevant page.
sheet_TokenUnlocks.tokenunlock_meta_description_web: Discover the token unlock and vesting schedules, plus tokenomics, for the leading crypto projects.
sheet_TokenUnlocks.vesting_type_cliff_description_web: Vesting schedule that assigns a custom amount of the allocation as a one-off
sheet_TokenUnlocks.vesting_type_deflationary_description_we: Vesting schedule that vests an increasingly smaller number of tokens each period with a certain frequency
sheet_TokenUnlocks.vesting_type_inflationary_description_we: Vesting schedule that vests an increasingly larger number of tokens each period with a certain frequency
sheet_TokenUnlocks.vesting_type_linear_description_web: Vesting schedule that vests linearly with a certain frequency
sheet_TokenUnlocks.vesting_type_non_linear_description_web: Vesting schedule that vests tokens in a way that is not linear, deflationary or inflationary
sheet_TokenUnlocks.vesting_type_tge_description_web: When a large amount of tokens is unlocked on the first day of the project launch, often followed by a linear vesting schedule
